## Safety and contract checks

- [ ] Uses synthetic data only.
- [ ] Does not add clinical advice or infer medicine correctness.
- [ ] Does not expose secrets or full phone numbers.
- [ ] Contract change is backward compatible, or increments `eventVersion`.
- [ ] Tests and type-check pass.
- [ ] Demo steps were updated if behavior changed.
